creature.name: Barkeep

mid.name: Bar Brawler
entries: The barkeep has been in enough bar fights to know how to throw a few punches. When fighting in their bar and making a nonlethal attack, the barkeep gains a +1 circumstance bonus to attack rolls and deals an additional 1d4 damage.

mid.name: Barkeep's Advice
entries: The barkeep gives some pertinent advice to a single creature other than themself. For 24 hours, when that creature fails a skill check or saving throw, they can recall this advice and reroll the check, using the second result instead. Once that creature uses this ability, its effect ends. A creature that receives the Barkeep's Advice is temporarily immune to the ability for 1 month.

mid.name: Destructive Vengeance
mid.trigger: An enemy within 15 feet damages the antipaladin
entries: The antipaladin increases the amount of damage they take by 2d6 and deals 2d6 damage to the triggering enemy, choosing evil or negative damage. In addition, the antipaladin deals 2 extra damage of the chosen type with their Strikes against the triggering creature until the end of the antipaladin's next turn.

entries: The antipaladin makes a melee Strike. If they hit and deal damage, the target is frightened 1, or frightened 2 on a critical hit.

_aon.markdown:
<title level="1" pfs="Limited">Antipaladin</title>

<row gap="medium">

<column gap="medium" flex="1 1 400px">

There is perhaps nothing more anathematic to peace than an antipaladin. Dedicated holy warriors to the darkest and foulest of deities, antipaladins work to fulfill the vile wishes of their evil masters. The zeal with which they implement the plans of dark gods makes them truly fearsome foes for anyone allied with the forces of good.

<column gap="tiny">

Unspecific Lore: DC 18

</column>

</column>

<aside>
<title level="2" noclass="true" icon="/images/Icons/Sidebar2AdditionalLore.png">Servants Of Destruction</title>

Antipaladins are the polar opposite of paladins: chaotic evil warriors devoted to destruction. Much like champions of good, they must follow a code. Their code exhorts evil and prohibits selfless acts. Antipaladins usually serve Lamashtu, Rovagug, or demon lords. Many antipaladins used to be champions of good and seek to destroy their former faiths.
</aside>
